Channels.note: As a product name keep English (Weblate glossary marks this explicitly). The common noun 'channels' is 'Kanäle'.

Gossip.note: Protocol name; never render literally. The Weblate glossary row 'Klatsch und Tratsch' is a literal mistranslation and must not be used.

Global Relay.note: Export format written 'Global-Relay-EML' in the Weblate glossary when compounded.

System Console.note: Feminine: die Systemkonsole. Consistent across webapp and mobile.

marketplace.note: Weblate glossary row contains the typo 'Martkplatz'; correct form is Marktplatz. Beware: the default channel 'Town Square' is also 'Marktplatz' in existing translations — disambiguate via context (Plugin-Marktplatz vs. channel name).

channel.note: Masculine: der Kanal, Plural Kanäle. Mandated by the German community rules.

team.note: Neuter: das Team. Mandated by the German community rules.

post.note: German community rules mandate 'Nachricht' for post (same as message). A few newer server strings use 'Beitrag'; prefer Nachricht.

thread.note: Consistently 'Unterhaltung' (not 'Thread') across webapp, server, and mobile; the Threads view is 'Unterhaltungen'.

direct message.note: Mandated by the German community rules. Abbreviation DM is not expanded in German UI; a few strings use 'direkte Nachricht' — prefer the compound.

mention.note: Verb: erwähnen. Mandated by the German community rules. '@mention' stays '@Erwähnung' or keeps the @username literal.

notification.note: Mandated by the German community rules.

pin.note: Pinned messages = 'Angeheftete Nachrichten'; unpin = 'Loslösen' / 'nicht mehr anheften'. Avoid the variant 'anpinnen' that appears in one webapp string.

bookmark.note: Neuter: das Lesezeichen. Verb usage: 'Lesezeichen hinzufügen'. Matches Weblate glossary.

saved messages.note: save = speichern, unsave = 'nicht mehr speichern' / 'Speichern rückgängig'.

status.note: Masculine: der Status; plural also Status.

custom status.note: Majority rendering; a few mobile strings shorten to 'eigener Status' — prefer 'benutzerdefinierter Status'.

do not disturb.note: Status label; keep without 'Bitte'. Abbreviation DND is not used in German UI.

out of office.note: Existing status label is '"Nicht im Büro"'. In prose about absence, 'abwesend' also appears.

guest.note: Masculine: der Gast, Plural Gäste. Guest access = Gastzugang.

member.note: Neuter: das Mitglied, Plural Mitglieder. Mandated by the German community rules.

user.note: Mandated by the German community rules (not 'Nutzer', which appears sporadically).

system admin.note: Also 'Systemadmin' in short labels; prefer the full compound.

session.note: Mandated by the German community rules.

sign in.note: Both 'sign in' and 'log in' = anmelden (noun: Anmeldung). Formal register: 'Melden Sie sich an'.

sign out.note: Both 'sign out' and 'log out' = abmelden (button: 'Abmelden'). Matches Weblate glossary.

join.note: Mandated by the German community rules. Takes dative: 'dem Kanal beitreten'.

unarchive.note: Existing UI and Weblate glossary use 'wiederherstellen' (Kanal wiederherstellen), not 'dearchivieren'.

mute.note: 'Kanal stummschalten'; unmute a channel = 'Stummschaltung aufheben'. Same verb is used for microphone mute in Calls.

unfollow.note: 'Nicht mehr folgen' is the established button label.

favorite.note: Masculine: der Favorit, Plural Favoriten (sidebar category 'Favoriten'). Verb: 'zu Favoriten hinzufügen'; unfavorite: 'aus Favoriten entfernen'.

search.note: Verb: suchen; 'browse' = durchsuchen per Weblate glossary.

slash command.note: Consistent existing rendering; keep the hyphenated half-English compound.

webhook.note: Masculine: der Webhook. Kept in English per Weblate glossary.

trigger word.note: Plural: Auslösewörter (per Weblate glossary). Command trigger word = Befehlsauslösewort.

plugin.note: Neuter: das Plugin. Kept in English per Weblate glossary.

bot.note: Masculine: der Bot. Bot account = Bot-Konto.

scheme.note: Neuter: das Schema, Plural Schemas/Schemata. Permission scheme = Berechtigungsschema.

seat.note: Majority rendering in licensing strings (Plural Sitze); 'Lizenzplatz' also appears once and is arguably clearer, but keep 'Sitz' for consistency.

trial.note: Majority rendering; 'Testphase'/'Testzeitraum' appear when a period is meant. Free trial = 'kostenlose Testversion'.

workspace.note: Strong majority (56 vs 2 occurrences of untranslated 'Workspace').

subscription.note: Per Weblate glossary; informal 'Abo' appears in a few strings but prefer Abonnement.

invite.note: Verb per Weblate glossary; as a noun use 'Einladung'.

shared channel.note: Majority rendering ('gemeinsamer Kanal'); 'geteilter Kanal' also occurs and the admin role name stays English ('Shared Channel Manager'). Keep 'gemeinsam' for consistency.

channel header.note: UI labels use 'Kanal-Kopfzeile'; body text is inconsistent ('Kanalüberschrift', 'Kopfzeile des Kanals'). Prefer Kanal-Kopfzeile; bare 'Header' = Kopfzeile.

system message.note: Write as one compound; an existing string has the incorrect spaced form 'System Nachricht'.

message priority.note: Existing strings vary between 'Nachrichtenpriorität' and 'Nachrichten-Priorität'; prefer the solid compound.

urgent.note: Priority label; lowercase 'dringend' in sentences. 'Important' = Wichtig.

recap.note: Webapp UI uses 'Rückblick'; server error strings use 'Zusammenfassung' (inconsistent). Prefer Rückblick to avoid clashing with summary = Zusammenfassung.

agent.note: Masculine: der Agent, Plural Agenten. 'AI agent' is rendered inconsistently as 'KI-Agent' and 'AI-Agent'; prefer 'KI-Agent'.

burn-on-read.note: Majority rendering ('Löschen-nach-Lesen-Nachricht'); some admin strings keep English 'Burn-on-Read'. Uppercase label: 'LÖSCHEN NACH LESEN'.

magic link.note: Webapp majority keeps English 'Magic Link' (10 vs 4); server strings use 'magischer Link'. Keep Magic Link for consistency with the user-facing webapp.

personal access token.note: Webapp majority uses 'Zugriffs-Token' (14 vs 1); the Weblate glossary row says 'Persönliches Zugangs-Token' — prefer the repo majority. Token is used masculine ('den Token').

announcement banner.note: Existing strings mix 'Ankündigungs-Banner' and 'Ankündigungsbanner'; prefer the hyphenated majority. Bare 'banner' = Banner (per Weblate glossary).

keyword.note: Notification settings use 'Schlüsselwörter'; compliance UI uses 'Stichworte' (inconsistent). For mention keywords use Schlüsselwort.

permalink.note: Majority keeps 'Permalink'; one string paraphrases 'dauerhafter Link'.

collapsed reply threads.note: Existing UI renders the feature name simply as 'Unterhaltungen' (mobile display settings). If a literal rendering is required, use 'Eingeklappte Unterhaltungen' — but prefer the established short form.

access control.note: Attribute-based access control = 'attributbasierte Zugriffskontrolle'; policy = Richtlinie.

attribute.note: Neuter: das Attribut, Plural Attribute. Custom profile attribute = 'benutzerdefiniertes Profilattribut'.

onboarding.note: Kept in English per Weblate glossary.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n. Caution: 'marketplace' (plugin store) is also 'Marktplatz' — rely on context; consider 'Plugin-Marktplatz' when ambiguity is possible.

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n.

read-only.note: Channel context uses 'Dieser Kanal ist schreibgeschützt'; admin strings also use 'Nur Lesen'/'Nur-Lese-…'. Prefer schreibgeschützt for channels.
